name: Rapid pass-through of received funds
description: Funds received into an account are forwarded onward within a very short period, often in near-equal amounts and leaving minimal balance.
fp: Legitimate payment intermediaries, treasury sweeps and agents routinely pass funds through quickly.

links.name: Rapid in-and-out movement of funds
links.ctx: Funds are received and moved on within a short period, leaving little residual balance.

links.name: Inbound funds quickly forwarded out in near-equal amounts
links.ctx: Pass-through behaviour with minimal retained balance.

links.name: Very short holding time between receipt and exit
links.ctx: Account behaves as a pass-through: most inbound value leaves within hours with minimal balance retained.

links.name: Receiving account rapidly forwards incoming credits
links.ctx: Mule-side: funds credited by multiple unrelated individuals are moved out within minutes or hours to other accounts, cash or crypto.

links.name: Rapid pass-through of received funds
links.ctx: Cross-border fraud proceeds are forwarded onward within minutes or hours in near-equal amounts, leaving minimal balance at each mule hop.

links.name: Inbound third-party payments followed by rapid outbound transfers
links.ctx: Account receives credits from unrelated payers and sends most funds onward within hours or days, retaining a small amount.

links.name: Funds quickly moved to unrelated parties or abroad
Pass-through flows with minimal balance
links.ctx: Funds enter and leave quickly in similar amounts with no operating cost.

links.name: Funds pass through quickly to personal accounts or unrelated entities
links.ctx: Charity account receives donations and immediately forwards most funds to individuals, personal accounts or businesses unrelated to stated objects.
